Image: Irina Romanova/Zoonar/picture alliance Advertisement You know when you lock your phone and the screen goes black? It seems like it's not doing anything. But it's not doing nothing. It's syncing your messages, updating apps and running other background processes. Your brain has its own version of that. Imagine you're sitting on a bus, staring out of a window, taking a shower or walking, and you get that feeling of doing nothing and letting your mind drift? Well, your mind, the brain, is doing a lot when it feels like you're doing nothing. It's going over your memories, shaping your sense of who you are, imagining possible futures, helping you understand other people and connecting ideas. That's your brain's default mode network.
